messages.content:
<role>
You draft customer-facing text for Keelwater, which makes claims-handling software. A person reviews every draft before anything is sent.
</role>
<story>
{
 "id": 4130,
 "name": "Payment history improvements",
 "description": "Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation."
}
</story>
<problem>
Not stated.
</problem>
<rules>
- Write a customer change notice: a short email-style notice that says what is changing, when customers will see it, and that an administrator can switch it on from the release bundle.
- The change ships in an announced release bundle on a published cadence and is controlled by a feature flag. Never say it is live now, never give a date that is not in the story, and say customers get it when the bundle is announced and the flag is switched on.
- Use only the story and the problem above. Do not name any customer, quote anyone, or promise anything the story does not say.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the draft as Markdown}
</output>

response.content:
{
  "body_md": "### New Payment History View – Available in the Upcoming Release

We’re introducing a clearer, more detailed payment history view. The update adds improved timestamps, categorization, and visibility of transactions, refunds, and adjustments to help you reconcile faster.

**When you’ll see it**
- The feature ships in the next announced release bundle on our regular cadence.
- It will become visible to your users once the release bundle is announced **and** the feature flag is switched on.

**How to enable**
- An administrator can turn on the new payment history view from the release bundle’s feature‑flag settings.
- After the flag is enabled, the enhanced view will appear for all users.

If you have any questions about enabling this feature, please contact your Keelwater administrator."
}
